verdict_commit_note: FINAL_VERDICT.json SHAs to be filled after the report-fill and final-fill commits; the implementation_commit df633f3 is the stage's research:replay commit, and the report_fill_commit and final_commit will be set by the docs:fill and pushed=true follow-up commits in this branch.
r4_decision_basis: R1/R2/R3 expected the fee proxy to be AGGRESSIVE (overestimated by 2-10x). R4's 24h Swap replay shows the proxy is CONSERVATIVE (underestimated by 100-1000x) for tight-range positions. The R1/R2 model assumed full-range LP, but real concentrated LPs earn much more per dollar due to l_factor amplification (1/(1-1/sqrt(1+R))^2 ≈ 1700 for ±5% range, 460 for ±10%). The 24h replay on the 3 top pools confirms $50 × 7d positions are strongly positive (net $20-$750 depending on pool and range), but the recommendation is GO_TINY_LIVE_PLAN_ONLY because the auto-exit wiring (R3 P0) is still missing.
why_R4_matters: R4 closes the largest remaining data uncertainty from R3 (the fee proxy calibration). R1/R2 expected the proxy to be aggressive; R4 shows it's conservative. R4 also produced 115,680 real Swap events that can be used by future stages (PnL accounting, fee emission simulation, IL replay).
